rows.note: Use this as the default way to say that two things are related or correlated.

example.english: These two things correlate, so we can't look at them separately.
example.traditional: 呢兩件事之間有關係，唔可以分開睇。
example.jyutping: ne1 loeng5 gin6 si6 zi1 gaan1 jau5 gwaan1 hai6 m4 ho2 ji5 fan1 hoi1 tai2

rows.traditional: 將 A 同 B 掛鈎
rows.jyutping: zoeng1 A tung4 B gwaa3 ngau1
rows.note: Use this when actively linking or comparing A with B as corresponding factors.

example.english: In research, we correlate sleep duration with work performance.
example.traditional: 做研究嗰陣，我哋會將睡眠時間同工作表現掛鈎。
example.jyutping: zou6 jin4 gau3 go2 zan6 ngo5 dei6 wui5 zoeng1 seoi6 min4 si4 gaan3 tung4 gung1 zok3 biu2 jin6 gwaa3 ngau1
